card.name: Stock legal wording in patent text
card.fires_on: Words inside US patent-style boilerplate, such as 'may' after 'the present invention' and in 'novel features believed characteristic of the invention'. Also fires on commas in claim openers.

modes.label: Data processing system boilerplate
modes.description: 'may' in 'the present invention may be implemented' or 'system that may be implemented as a server'.
modes.example: a pictorial representation of a distributed data processing system is depicted in which the present invention<< may>> be implemented.

modes.label: Novel features sentence
modes.description: Words in the standard sentence 'The novel features believed characteristic of the invention are set forth in the appended claims'.
modes.example: The recording of events is performed until the user stops the process. The novel<< features>> believed characteristic of the invention are set forth

modes.label: Claim openers
modes.description: The comma after 'recording events' at the start of a claim.
modes.example: A system for recording events<<,>> comprising: means for loading an application;
